title: Full-Funnel Architecture
objectives: Architect an end-to-end multi-campaign marketing funnel
Allocate budget rationally across TOFU (70%), MOFU (15%), and BOFU (15%)
Align creative messaging to cold discovery, warm trust, and hot urgency

blocks.text: Welcome to Tier 3: Strategist! Now we manage multi-lakh budgets with full-funnel precision.
A full-funnel account structure divides budget into cold customer acquisition (TOFU), trust nurturing (MOFU), and checkout closing (BOFU).

rows: High-energy video Reels, hooks, UGC problem-solving
Founder story, media features, customer reviews, unboxings
Dynamic Product Ads (DPA), limited-time discounts, free shipping

blocks.title: The Cricket Team Analogy
blocks.text: TOFU is your opening batsmen scoring runs. MOFU is your middle-order stabilizing the innings. BOFU is your finisher hitting boundaries in the final over! You need all three to win the match.
Use Campaign Budget Optimization (Advantage Campaign Budget - CBO) on mature scaling funnels to let Meta distribute money dynamically.
Never spend 50% of budget on retargeting unless you already have millions of organic monthly website visitors.

quiz.q: In a balanced e-commerce funnel, what percentage of ad budget should typically be allocated to cold Top-of-Funnel acquisition?
quiz.explain: Cold acquisition must receive the lion's share (70-80%) to continually introduce new prospects into the buying cycle.

quiz.q: What creative message is best suited for the Middle of Funnel (MOFU)?
options: Trust building: Founder origin story, doctor or press endorsements, and real customer reviews
A black and white image with no text
A meme completely unrelated to your product
quiz.explain: MOFU prospects already know your brand; they need trust, social proof, and reassurance to overcome hesitation.

quiz.q: True or False: If you stop funding Top-of-Funnel cold ads, your retargeting pool will eventually shrink and become unprofitable.
quiz.explain: True! The retargeting pool is fed by cold traffic. Without new visitors entering, retargeting quickly burns out.

quiz.q: Order the funnel stages from earliest customer touchpoint to final transaction.
quiz.explain: Customers discover the brand at TOFU, build trust at MOFU, convert at BOFU, and repeat at Post-Purchase.

recap: Structure campaigns into 70% TOFU (Cold), 15% MOFU (Warm), and 15% BOFU (Hot).
Match creative to consideration stage: Hooks for cold, Trust for warm, and Urgency for hot.
